title: JMS recovery after a replacement connection fails preparation
summary: After reset the merged JMS factory recovered on C. Direct reinitialization followed by the same failure left the retry on closed A.

change.description: SingleConnectionFactory now prepares each new physical connection before installing it and attempts to close the candidate when preparation raises JMSException.

notes: A deterministic Jakarta JMS provider records every creation, listener installation and physical close. It refuses sessions after a physical close. All application calls use the public Spring factory.
